Awful meals, Don’t go
Sep 2018 • Couples
Walked past this place and went in for lunch. My partner and I ordered a hot dog and chips and a beef cutlet which comes with pasta and salad. We also ordered a iced coffee and a beer. The beer was fine but the iced coffee had so much sugar in (and another strange taste I couldn’t pinpoint) that I couldn’t drink it. The waitress didn’t speak any english so I figured I’ll just leave the coffee drink. 

The hot dog had sooo much sauce on it was the most soggy messy thing to eat (and I like a lot of sauce)- the sausage was also cold as in I think they just picked it off the salad cart buffet they have downstairs. The chips were fine but it was the smallest portion ever, not good value at all.

Then we waited 20minutes from the first meal to the second meal coming. The pasta was cold and sweet (like it had some sugar syrup on). Overall, a terrible meal, wouldn’t recommend. Maybe some of the more traditional foods are appreciated by the Russians, as I can’t figure out why else this place has good reviews.

Take Cash
Jul 2018 • Couples
My partner and I came across this cafe in one of the back streets and it looked ok so we stopped in for lunch with our toddler. We sat upstairs which was nice. The waitress spoke very little English but we managed to get our order. I had a Sizzling Korean Bulgogi which was pretty tasty and my Partner had a type of Hungarian Pancake that she said was absolutely delicious. Just before we were leaving I had gone downstairs to see if they took Eftpos which they didn’t so I went to an ATM, when I had went to pay the guy had asked if I’d had anything smaller which I didn’t as I only had what the ATM gave me, he didn’t look too impressed and had to go get change which I thought was a bit ridiculous. So make sure you have cash and that the cash are smaller notes than 500,000 Dong.
